Incidence rate or prevalence with analytic confidence intervals

est_inc_prev.Rd

Incidence uses exact Poisson (chi-squared) CIs; prevalence uses Wilson or Clopper-Pearson CIs. CIs assume independent observations.

Usage

est_inc_prev(
  n_pat,
  n_out,
  py = NULL,
  scale_IR,
  type = "incidence",
  CImethod = NULL
)

Arguments

n_pat

number of patients (individuals)

n_out

number of outcomes

py

person years of follow up

scale_IR

how should the incidence/prevalence be scaled; i.e., incidence per X units of person-time

type

"incidence" or "prevalence"

CImethod

"wilson" or "clopper" based estimation of CIs

Value

data.frame with ir_est, ir_lb, ir_ub, scaled by scale_IR. All -88 if py == 0.
